title: Solution Architect
department: Airtel Business - Domestic.Business Solution Group & Product
jobDescription:
Solution Architect – Airtel Enterprise Solutions

Role Purpose

The Solution Architect will design, architect, and drive end-to-end technology solutions for enterprise and strategic customers across connectivity, cloud, Io T, security, and digital platforms. The role bridges business requirements with scalable, secure, and resilient technical architectures aligned to Airtel’s portfolio.

Experience Required

  • Up to 5 years of overall IT / Telecom / Enterprise solutions experience

  • 3-5 years in a Solution Architect / Pre-sales / Technical Design role

  • Strong exposure to telecom, IT services, cloud, or managed services environments

  • Experience working with large enterprises or government customers

  • Proven capability in customer-facing solution design and RFP/RFI responses

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end solution architecture for enterprise deals and programs

  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and cost-effective architecture

  • Design solutions spanning connectivity, cloud, security, data center, Io T, and digital services

  • Lead technical pre-sales, solution workshops, and customer presentations

  • Work closely with sales, product, delivery, and partner teams

  • Ensure architectures follow industry best practices, compliance, and Airtel standards

  • Support solution costing, documentation, and handover to delivery teams

Core Technology & Domain Expertise

Telecom & Network

  • MPLS, SD-WAN, VPN, DIA, LAN/WAN

  • Network security fundamentals (FW, IDS/IPS, ZTNA concepts)

  • Understanding of 5G, Io T connectivity, and edge use cases (good to have)

Cloud & Data Center

  • Hands-on architecture exposure to AWS / Azure / GCP (at least one)

  • Hybrid cloud, VPC/VNET design, DR & high-availability architectures

  • Colocation, DC migration, BCDR, backup strategies

Security

  • Enterprise security architectures

  • Secure network design, identity & access concepts

  • Familiarity with SOC, SIEM, SSE, SASE models (preferred)

Enterprise & Digital

  • Application hosting, middleware, APIs, microservices (high-level)

  • Understanding of ERP/CRM ecosystems (SAP, Oracle, Salesforce – conceptual)

  • Knowledge of Io T platforms, smart city, OT / industrial solutions (preferred)

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong architecture thinking and solution design skills

  • Excellent customer communication and presentation abilities

  • Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business stakeholders

  • Commercial awareness and solution costing mindset

  • Strong documentation and proposal writing capability

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP – Architect level preferred)

  • Networking certifications (CCNP / equivalent – good to have)

  • Security certifications (CCSP, CISSP – added advantage)

jobDescription:
Job Title: Key Account Manager – Business Development

Job Level: Manager / Senior Manager

Function: Sales

Location : Airtel Centre

Reporting to : Lead - Business Development & Airtel Digital Carrier Platform

Date : 28-05-2026

Purpose of the Job - Business Development Manager – Global Wholesale Voice will be responsible for identifying, acquiring, and activating new carrier, operator, and wholesale voice accounts across international markets. The role is primarily a hunter position, focused on generating new business opportunities, opening strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and converting signed partnerships into live traffic and profitable revenue. This person will work closely with routing, pricing, finance and operations teams to ensure every new account moves efficiently from prospecting to onboarding to steady business generation.

1) The candidate will be responsible to maximize new customer additions and increase Airtel’s global reach.

2) He/ she will have to maximize revenues from existing accounts by selling IDD voice termination, Message hub and ITFS solutions.

Deliverables (Maximum 5-6 key responsibilities)

1) Onboard New Accounts and undertake Business Development

2) Revenue enhancement & penetration of the account

- Implement the GR mandate

- Ensuring NR from accounts by entering into swaps & traded deals on regular basis

- Strategize & plan in order to increase minutes (orders)

- Own the P&L of the account

3) Multi portfolio sale including wholesale voice, SMS Hub, ITFS, etc.

- Identify, lead and convert into sales

- Coordinate with internal teams such as product, finance, settlements to ensure that Airtel wins the order

- Deliver customer satisfaction by ensuring timely implementation of the solution

4) To keep a close tab on competition and enhancing business/preparing price points in order to churn away carriers from competition

5) Responsible for managing cost of the destination in the account / region to help Airtel’s retail outgoing cost & to generate wholesale business

6) Ensure timely market intelligence & competitor strategies are communicated to key stakeholders

7) Create high visibility for Brand Airtel in the designated region/s

Hunting Focus :

· Identify, target, and qualify new wholesale voice customers including carriers, mobile operators, international hubs, and strategic telecom partners.

· Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of prospects by region, traffic type, and strategic fit.

· Develop account acquisition plans for target markets and priority named accounts.

· Lead outbound business development efforts through direct outreach, referrals, networking, and participation in industry events.

· Own the full sales cycle from first contact through commercial negotiation, contracting, onboarding, and handover to operations/account management where applicable.

· Create compelling business cases for each target account, including expected traffic potential, margin opportunity, credit considerations, and strategic value.

· Negotiate rate agreements, interconnect terms, payment/commercial conditions, and service commitments in alignment with company objectives.

· Coordinate internally with pricing, routing, fraud, finance, legal, and technical teams to ensure timely feasibility checks and account activation.

Decision level

Prime: Final Decision Making authority, accountable to the Management

1) Create Account funnel

2) Segment Customers

3) Strategy to Increase RMS in the region

4) Product and Services penetration strategy for the region

5) Managing cost of termination for the region

Shared: Decisions reached jointly with peers on a collective basis

1) Pricing decision in case of deviation

2) Selecting the customers which can be invested in for long term relationships

3) Commercial decisions to support existing carriers

Contributory: Makes a major contribution to a decision or policy judgment reached by others

1)Expansion into new Segments

2) Developing new partnerships in the region

Demonstrate (Key competencies)

- Hunter mindset with high drive, resilience, and urgency.

- Strong commercial judgment and disciplined deal qualification.

- Ability to open doors, build credibility quickly, and influence decision-makers.

- Appreciation of the business/ industry nuances

- High degree of business skill

- Customer centric actions

- General management qualities

- Global mindset (working with customers with different cultural backgrounds operating in different time zones)

- Networking and interpersonal skills

- Collaboration with internal & external partners

- Enterprising and entrepreneurial mindset

- Leadership qualities

Educational Level

Must have: BE/ MBA

Working Experience

Must have: At least 1 year experience in relevant industry/ field

Dimensions

Impact of position on :

i) Gross Revenue :The candidate will manage revenue of customers that are brought in via hunting and then farm those customers / accounts to their full potential

Impact on customers :

i) Type of customers Mainly Internal Mainly External Fair mix of Internal &

External

No. of Subordinates :

i) Direct-0

ii)Indirect- 0

title: Business Development Manager - Broadband
jobDescription:
JOB DESCRIPTION


Born in 1995, Airtel aims to offer global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our presence is positioned to serve nearly 96% of the nation's population with infrastructure to sustain cutting-edge technologies such as 5G, Io T, IQ, and Airtel Black. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for consumers, while also preserving the ecological balance.


We create impact, take early ownership, and experiment with different career paths as part of our cultural fabric. Here’s what you will get to experience as an Airtel employee:


Limitless Impact:


You get to make a difference to internal and external customers by taking small and big ideas to success and therefore leaving footprints at the scale of billions. And beyond. Limitless Ownership:


You get to go above and beyond to take responsibility, challenge the norms and take risks to create big things in more ways than one. Limitless Careers:


You have the freedom to imagine, and an open canvas available to you to experiment and implement new ideas to gain depth and breadth of experiences.


So come join us, and #Be Limitless. Because you are.


Job Details


Job Title Business Development Manager

Designation Business Development Manager

Job Code

Function Broadband

Sub-Function Franchise

Location Circle

Level/Grade Senior Executive / Assistant Manager


Position Description


The purpose of the role is to manage the network roll-out and installation of Airtel broadband in collaboration with Local Cable Operators (LCOs). The role will be responsible to act as a bridge between Airtel and Local Cable Operators (LCOs).


Organizational Relationship


Reporting To Regional Manager – Broadband Franchise

Total number of employees supervised by you DIRECTLY or INDIRECTLY

Managerial Individual Contributors

Directly - -

Indirectly - -


Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities


Network Planning

Identify pocket opportunities to expand Airtel’s network basis extraction.

Build infrastructure for home networks to maximize utilization of Airtel services.

Extract data such as utilization % (homes using Airtel) for different pockets and shortlist suitable pockets for future expansion.

Prepare plan for the roll-out of the home passes to ensure optimization of the network.

Seek approval from the Regional Manager and the Network team on the home-passes roll-out plan.

Formulate strategy to drive engagement and profitability for the local cable operators (LCOs).

Partner Identification and Engagement

Liaise with the Local Cable Operators (LCOs) channel to identify right partners for the network roll-out.

Identify the nature of potential local cable operators required for the network roll-out.

Ensure engagement of LCO partners through smooth on-boarding and ensuring profitability for them.

Execute and manage training for LCOs on Airtel systems, apps & processes.

Network Implementation

Identify potential clusters for new rollout of network across the circle & share inputs with the network planning team.

Create capacity of broadband services through tie-ups with local cable operators (LCOs).

Business Delivery

Design processes and systems for quality home pass coverage to drive utilization and customer base; Ensure zero lead loss

Stakeholder Management

Create systems to ensure that 100% partners are profitable basis right financial exposure and investments

Display customer obsession to deliver best in class network experience with timely correction or upgradation in network

Network Understanding

Collaboration and Influence

Ownership Mindset

Navigating Change

title: Order Manager
jobDescription:
Job Details – OE Compliance Manager

Designation – Deputy Manager

Deputy Manager – OE Compliance

Office Location Airtel Centre

Position Description- The OE Compliance Manager is responsible for driving end-to-end compliance governance, audit readiness, documentation controls, revenue assurance validations, and contract repository management across all business segments. The role ensures adherence to organizational policies, regulatory requirements, audit standards, and billing governance frameworks while maintaining a 100% audit-ready environment. The incumbent collaborates closely with Business Heads, Finance, Legal, Revenue Assurance, KAMs, and Operations teams to mitigate compliance risks, prevent revenue leakage, and strengthen process controls.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage Internal, External, and Revenue Assurance (RA) audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
  • Ensure 100% documentation compliance across Enterprise, Emerging Business, Government, ISP, Global Business, and Nxtra segments.
  • Govern centralized repositories for customer agreements including MSA, NDA, MOU, ITFS Agreements, Channel Partner Agreements, and other legal documents.
  • Perform monthly Revenue Assurance reconciliations and identify discrepancies between operational and billing systems.
  • Drive governance and closure of Zero Value Orders and inventory reconciliation cases.
  • Conduct compliance audits, quality checks, and document validations across circles and business segments.
  • Maintain audit trails, compliance records, and evidence repositories for regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Monitor and report compliance adherence through dashboards and management MIS reports.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Coordinate with auditors, Legal, Finance, Sales, KAMs, and Operations teams for audit and compliance requirements.
  • Track and drive closure of non-compliance cases through stakeholder reviews and governance forums.
  • Collect and maintain quarterly compliance certifications from Business Heads and functional stakeholders.
  • Manage contract uploads and repository administration through systems such as Icertis.
  • Publish periodic compliance, audit, and governance dashboards.
  • Recommend process improvements, automation opportunities, and control enhancements to reduce compliance risks and improve operational efficiency.
  • Support special projects related to governance, compliance transformation, and audit management.

title: Zonal Sales Manager
jobDescription:
Function: Sales
Reporting To: Zonal Business Manager
Level: Manager / Senior Manager

Purpose of the Role

The Zonal Sales Manager will be responsible for leading and managing frontline Territory Sales Managers (TSMs) while driving sales growth across assigned territories. The role focuses on strengthening distribution, maximizing market penetration, enhancing customer acquisition, and ensuring the achievement of key business objectives through effective stakeholder and channel partner management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strengthen the distribution and sales network by expanding SIM and Data-selling outlets across the assigned cluster.

  • Drive market share growth, customer acquisition, and sales of high-value products and digital offerings.

  • Develop and execute monthly business plans based on market insights, competitive analysis, and performance trends.

  • Manage channel partners to improve distribution effectiveness, channel profitability, and partner satisfaction.

  • Lead and mentor a team of Territory Sales Managers to deliver business targets and operational excellence.

  • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Market Communications, and Customer Service teams to achieve business KPIs.

  • Monitor competitive activities and provide actionable market feedback to support business strategies.

  • Coach and develop team members, preparing them for larger responsibilities and leadership opportunities.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong people leadership and team management capabilities.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

  • Strong analytical, planning, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Commercial acumen with a result-oriented approach.

  • Influencing, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic business environment.

Educational Qualifications

  • MBA / PGDM from a recognized institute.

Experience Required

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in Telecom, FMCG, Consumer Durable, Retail, or other related industries.

  • Proven track record in sales, distribution management, and team leadership.

title: ZSM - Pune
jobDescription:
About Airtel

Founded in 1995, Airtel is a leading force in global connectivity, empowering over 96% of India’s population with next-gen solutions including 5G, Io T, cloud, and integrated services like Airtel Black. At Airtel, we go beyond business goals to create meaningful impact— for customers, communities, and the planet.

We’re a culture built on ownership, experimentation, and impact — where every team member is empowered to lead, innovate, and grow their career across diverse paths.

Come, #Be Limitless — because you are.

What Makes Airtel a Great Place to Work?

  • Limitless Impact: Create measurable impact at scale — your ideas and efforts touch millions.

  • Limitless Ownership: Take charge, challenge the norm, and drive bold outcomes.

Limitless Careers: Chart your path across roles, verticals, and innovation

Purpose of the Job

This role provides an opportunity for the incumbent to execute the organization’s strategy in the assigned geography with a team of ~15 Account Managers. He/ She will own the revenue generation (Hunting) and maintenance (farming) across all Lo Bs – Data/Corporate Postpaid/Fixed Line/New Products. As the Zonal Sales Manager, the incumbent will mentor and guide the AMs, and work towards building the right capabilities in the team. He/ She will connect will work with internal stakeholders to drive the Serve[1]to-sell model for all B2B Accounts, govern the relevant performance parameters for the team on a regular basis and take corrective actions.

Key Deliverables Go-to-Market Strategy:

· Execute the GTM strategy in the assigned zone with a team of ~15 Account Managers

· Build sales plans, forecasts, funnel and strategies to achieve sales targets and profitability growth

· Deliver as per the assigned targets for sales, revenue growth, churn and product mix for the respective zone

· Allocate targets to respective AM basisterritory potential

· Focus on both Hunting and Farming initiatives in the assigned zone

· Analyze the Customer inputs captured by the team in the BUC (Bottom Up Construct) to build prospects

· Work with Market Planning team for driving fiber network expansion in the identified potential B2B buildings and clusters

· Ensure the cascade and implementation of Serve-to-Sell model across the team for building and promoting stronger, long-lasting Customer relationships

· Build Digital capability in the team and drive new Work-ways leaning heavily on digital initiative

People Leadership:

· Ensure right hiring, team motivation and alignment to set goals and priorities

· Ensure timely cascade of goals and target to the AMs and review them periodically

· Track performance against the goals regularly, provide constructive feedback with relevant examples, and take corrective actions

· Connect with Account Managers on weekly basis,seek feedback and take necessary action

· Identify learning needs of the team and partner with HR to get the same delivered

· Drive regular rewards and recognition programs as per Central guideline

Trend analysis & Action

· Review the sales forecasts shared by the team and provide necessary support for closures

· Make revenue forecast in line with the assigned target and take necessary action wherever required

· Identify emerging trends in the geography, especially for the new products and plan to leverage the same along with the relevant stakeholders

· Keep track of competition plans and market insights and use them for enhancing the ARPA, NAP in the geography

#BAL

title: Store Manager Mumbai 2
jobDescription:
Job Title: Store Manager Job Level:
Function: Retail Location : Circle

RESPONSIBILITIES: -

Located in the store, this role has direct responsibility for the successful running of the Airtel store. The person will
ensure compliance with agreed guidelines to deliver a best in class experience & ensure store revenue & cost
targets are met.

Deliverables (Maximum 5-6 key responsibilities)

 Store Operations & Audit / Compliance:
 Adherence of Store Operations in line with pre-defined SOPs
 Ensure that the look and feel of the store is as per guidelines/standards
 Track efficient Cash handling; prevent shoplifting / ensure safety and security
 Visual merchandising as per plan / guidelines
 Inventory and stock management to prevent stock-outs or excess Inventory
 KPI reporting as per guidelines and on-time
 Strategic Roll outs:
 Accountable for clearing store for formal launch as per pre-defined procedure across dimensions
(e.g. manpower/ furniture & fittings/ IT/ device inventory)
 Manage closure of current store during refit & conversion
 Profitability:
 To achieve the target on conversion from the walk in customers in terms of Sales from new
acquisitions & up-sell
 To ensure required MIS & tracking at CRO levels
 Manage Store expenses are as per plan
 Provide suggestions /feedback to improve store productivity
 People Development / Team Management:
 To ensure daily roistering & briefing to outsourced store staff
 Ensure that attrition issues (planned & unplanned) are escalated for timely resolution
 Ensure motivation & development of outsourced store staff
 Customer Experience:
 Ensure adherence to CE guidelines
 Manage staff allocation based on demand at point in time
 Personally step in to handle demanding customers
 Provide suggestions for improvements in CE

title: Solution Architect
department: Airtel Business - Domestic.Business Solution Group & Product
jobDescription:
Solution Architect – Airtel Enterprise Solutions

Role Purpose

The Solution Architect will design, architect, and drive end-to-end technology solutions for enterprise and strategic customers across connectivity, cloud, Io T, security, and digital platforms. The role bridges business requirements with scalable, secure, and resilient technical architectures aligned to Airtel’s portfolio.

Experience Required

  • Up to 5 years of overall IT / Telecom / Enterprise solutions experience

  • 3-5 years in a Solution Architect / Pre-sales / Technical Design role

  • Strong exposure to telecom, IT services, cloud, or managed services environments

  • Experience working with large enterprises or government customers

  • Proven capability in customer-facing solution design and RFP/RFI responses

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end solution architecture for enterprise deals and programs

  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and cost-effective architecture

  • Design solutions spanning connectivity, cloud, security, data center, Io T, and digital services

  • Lead technical pre-sales, solution workshops, and customer presentations

  • Work closely with sales, product, delivery, and partner teams

  • Ensure architectures follow industry best practices, compliance, and Airtel standards

  • Support solution costing, documentation, and handover to delivery teams

Core Technology & Domain Expertise

Telecom & Network

  • MPLS, SD-WAN, VPN, DIA, LAN/WAN

  • Network security fundamentals (FW, IDS/IPS, ZTNA concepts)

  • Understanding of 5G, Io T connectivity, and edge use cases (good to have)

Cloud & Data Center

  • Hands-on architecture exposure to AWS / Azure / GCP (at least one)

  • Hybrid cloud, VPC/VNET design, DR & high-availability architectures

  • Colocation, DC migration, BCDR, backup strategies

Security

  • Enterprise security architectures

  • Secure network design, identity & access concepts

  • Familiarity with SOC, SIEM, SSE, SASE models (preferred)

Enterprise & Digital

  • Application hosting, middleware, APIs, microservices (high-level)

  • Understanding of ERP/CRM ecosystems (SAP, Oracle, Salesforce – conceptual)

  • Knowledge of Io T platforms, smart city, OT / industrial solutions (preferred)

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong architecture thinking and solution design skills

  • Excellent customer communication and presentation abilities

  • Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business stakeholders

  • Commercial awareness and solution costing mindset

  • Strong documentation and proposal writing capability

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP – Architect level preferred)

  • Networking certifications (CCNP / equivalent – good to have)

  • Security certifications (CCSP, CISSP – added advantage)

title: Circle Head - Wireline Deployment
jobDescription:
Position –Circle Head - Wireline Deployment.

Purpose of the Job

  • Responsible to handle the Fiber rollout and Transmission ISP Implementation in circle to meet internal & External customer requirement either new Bandwidth provisioning / Network Robustness.
  • Handling the vendor Management, Material Management, Program Management, coordinate with planning, SCM, No C, Store, Network Quality, Circle Marketing, FTTH planning & Circle mobility teams so as to execute and deliver the required backhaul or LM fiber optic & transmission network to support further delivery of customer serving networks like Mobility, FTTH, FTTBs and other band width requirements etc.
  • Responsible for handling the Digitization of Fiber Force app and GIS system for the ONLINE data / monitoring through system.
  • Responsible for “Right of Way” from the different Govt authorities through allotted partner, validating the commercial payment and processing further payment to concern authority for getting the official permission for execution of Fiber rollout and also recovery of BG or Security Deposit with coordination of ROW spoc & Partner.
  • Responsible for material captilization, Inventory reduction, to support partner for material consumption.

Deliverables

• Fiber Rollout : Execution of fiber rollout with quality delivery of Intercity / Intracity /FTTH Fiber for the NLD / LMC / Home-passes, network Operations / expansion needs as well as to meet other business delivery commitments/expansion requirements of end customer serving networks like Mobility,FTTH & B2B etc. Has to ensure 100% AT for executed fiber KM/no. of LM's/Home-passes.
• Network Implementation: Implementation of the new Network or Element (Core / Collector) or OLT to meet the internal or External customer bandwidth requirement on time and up gradation of Network capacity as per the Planning of Transmission and also optimization of the Network Element
• To establish suitable processes in order to set and monitor benchmark KPIs and Metrics for all the deliverables so as to ensure execution of goals and objectives
• To Ensure the Vendor Management in place to deliver the Routes / Nodes/ Home-passes as per the Network requirement
• To Monitor and controlling the ISP / OSP inventory
• To build collaborative relationships with key stakeholders & Third party vendor so as to bring the benefits to the unit in terms of Fiber Rollout and Network Implementation efficiency.
• To ensure the feasibility for new fiber rollout / node delivery/ FTTH/Home pass delivery.

Educational Level

Qualification-

B.E/B.Tech with 10-15 years of experience in OSP/ISP of Transport, FTTH & MPLS Networks .

Experience of handling large project into fiber deployment

Effective communication/interpersonal skills to manage team and customer

title: Lead - Business Planning & Consumer Insights
jobDescription:
Purpose of the Job

To Plan and track key Business indicators (including Revenue elements, Market & Competition intelligence and Network Planning) aimed at ensuring business hygiene, providing right direction to the product team towards designing consumer value proposition and generating a feedback mechanism on any revenue related deviations.

Deliverables (Key responsibilities)

· Will be responsible to Analyze Revenue and Marketing data to help the businesses to achieve the Targeted Revenue & IRMS

· Will ensure analysis and Revenue Forecasting

· Will be responsible to do Revenue Tracking & Revenue Analysis

· Product Portfolio control & rationalization

· Market and Competitive Intelligence

· Ensure Network Planning & Optimization

· Regularly Ensure compliance of Marketing Processes

Major Challenges :

The key challenge in this role is to effectively manage the diverse data requirements and associated analytics. Given the nature of Telecom business and the amount of multi-dimensional data possibilities, it is very easy to end up devoting energy and resources in fruitless & non value adding work and analysis. The severity of this challenge is accentuated even more because of the paucity of human resources available in the function.

The key to overcoming this challenge is establishing a robust KPI monitoring mechanism wherein we delve deep and generate insight only in areas where the trend is different from the norm. Essentially, the prioritization mechanism needs to be very robust.

Demonstrate (Key competencies)

· Analytical skills & able to handle large volume of data with highest accuracy levels

· Decision making process & provide insights to the business.

· Understanding of market dynamics.

· Flexible to adopt changes as per business requirement.

· Self-motivated and self -starter.

jobDescription:
Job Title: International Roaming Alliance & Partnerships Head

Job Level: DGM

Function: Global Voice

Location : Airtel Centre

Reporting to : Head : Roaming & Mobile Solutions

Date : 15th July 2026

Purpose of the Job

· Responsible to Manage the P&L for the Roaming business which is contributing to NR of >50%

· Make Airtel leader in the Roaming business in India by driving cost & revenue in a direction to enhance pack coverage and total roaming revenue in collaboration with Marketing, Customer experience, network, IT and RA

Deliverables (Maximum 5-6 key responsibilities)

  • Negotiation with the Operators for the outroaming cost and Inroaming revenue, close contracts, settlements and maintain relationship with them.

  • Support the Marketing team with country coverage and cost for new packs to be launched

  • Manage traffic steering according to the negotiated rates to optimize cost and review achievements for the commitments.

  • Track the traffic, performance of the alliances regularly (revenue and cost)

  • Tap Implementation, Rating Validation, RAP monitoring and work closely with RA/Mediation/IT/Clearing House team for ensuring no revenue loss and complete billing.

  • Support Finance with accurate revenue /cost booking, timely settlement and collection, forecast, bad debt and reconciliations.

Major Challenges :

  • Single handedly manage >520 partners, large amount of follow up

  • Track traffic and revenue/cost movement

  • Revenue and cost forecasting

  • High External and Cross functional dependency

  • Up to date with market developments

  • Manage partnerships in all times zones

Decision level

Prime:

· Revenue and cost projections

· Accept ./ reject deviations in rates

· Day to day coordination

· Contract finalisation

Shared:

· Final negotiation

· Audit & Compliance

· Marketing initiatives

Contributory:

· Strategic partnerships

· New Business opportunities

· Cross functional projects

· Marketing product enhancements

·

Demonstrate (Key competencies)

- Leadership qualities

- Customer focus

- Teamwork and collaboration

- Negotiation & Communication skills

- Execution excellence

- Hunger to win

- Analytical and problems Solving

- Networking and inter-personal skills

Educational Level

Must have: Bachelor degree

title: Project Manager
location: Airtel Centre - Gurgaon, Gurgaon, Haryana , India
jobDescription:
About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Program Manager to lead and oversee the delivery of our complex SD-Branch implementation projects. In this pivotal role, you will be the central point of contact, responsible for ensuring the successful planning, execution, and completion of SD-Branch projects from conception to operational handover.

Key Responsibilities

• End-to-End Program Leadership: Manage the entire lifecycle of multiple, concurrent SD-WAN deployment programs, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget.

• Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary liaison between clients, internal engineering teams, security teams, and leadership. Provide regular, clear updates on program status, risks, and milestones.

• Technical Strategy & Planning: Develop and own the overall program plan, including technical requirements, resource allocation, risk mitigation strategies, and detailed rollout schedules.

• Security Integration: Leverage your deep security expertise to guide the integration of next-generation firewalls (specifically Fortigate or Cisco) into the SD-WAN architecture, ensuring compliance with security policies.

• Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify, track, and mitigate program risks and technical issues. Escalate critical concerns appropriately and drive them to resolution.

• Vendor & Resource Coordination: Coordinate with technology vendors (e.g., Cisco, Fortinet, VMware), carriers, and internal resources to ensure seamless project execution.

• Quality Assurance: Ensure all delivered solutions meet the defined technical, security, and performance standards. Oversee the creation and handoff of all project documentation.


Key Deliverables

· Customer engagement & communication

· Project kick off meeting/call with Customer

· Resolution of customer dependencies

· Share Project Plan with the customer

· e2e tracking & monitoring of project delivery

· Proactive & timely project status update to the customer

· Project Stage tracking & ensure timely delivery

· Project follow ups, escalations and constraint resolution

· Delivery of third party media/bandwidth

· Customer CPE integration & testing

· Schedule planned activities with the customers

· Accelerate & Maximize revenue by faster deployment of project


Skills Required

· Good understanding of project management concepts and methodology

· Excellent relationship management with customer, cross functional team

· Good written and verbal communication skills

· Good understanding of products, services

· Good planning & execution skills

· Can do attitude & problem solving skills

· Quick thinking & analytical ability

· Process orientation and eye for detail

· Result Orientation


Required Qualifications & Experience


• Overall Experience: A minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in IT/Network program or project management, with a significant focus on network infrastructure.


Technical Expertise (Mandatory):

o Deep, hands-on technical knowledge of Routing & Switching (BGP, OSPF, MPLS) and Network Security principles.

o Hands-on experience configuring, deploying, and troubleshooting either Fortigate or Cisco Firewalls.

o Proven experience managing large-scale SD-WAN deployments (e.g., Cisco Viptela, VMware SD-WAN, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Silver Peak).


Program Management Skills:

o Expertise in program management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) and tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet).

o Strong financial acumen with experience managing multi-million dollar program budgets.

o Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills.


Certifications (Preferred):

o One or more is highly desirable: PMP, Pg MP, PMI-ACP.

Educational Qualifications

· 6 – 10 years project execution experience in Telecom/ISP industry

  • Sound understanding of telecom technology,

products & services

Work Experience

· Diploma Technical, preferably B.E/B.Tech

· Qualify CS Hiring Test

· Strong communication skills

· Strong planning and execution skills

title: Account Manager - B2B Sales_AP
location: AP-Hyderabad-Splendid Towers-Circle, Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh , India
jobDescription:
Born in 1995, Airtel aims to offer global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our presence is positioned to serve nearly 96% of the nation's population with infrastructure to sustain cutting-edge technologies such as 5G, Io T, IQ, and Airtel Black. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for consumers, while also preserving the ecological balance.


We create impact, take early ownership, and experiment with different career paths as part of our cultural fabric. Here’s what you will get to experience as an Airtel employee:


Limitless Impact: You get to make a difference to internal and external customers by taking small and big ideas to success and therefore leaving footprints at the scale of billions. And beyond.

Limitless Ownership: You get to go above and beyond to take responsibility, challenge the norms and take risks to create big things in more ways than one

Limitless Careers: You have the freedom to imagine, and an open canvas available to you to experiment and implement new ideas to gain depth and breadth of experiences.


So come join us, and #Be Limitless.


Position Description

The purpose of this role is :

  • To ensure business acquisition/growth in his territory by delivering Data (Internet Bandwidth, MPLS, Cloud etc.), Voice (Postpaid), Broadband and Fixed Line Business
  • Front-end the relationship with customer from Airtel side and become the single point of contact for customer for all three lines of business.
  • Ensure Customer Market Share (CMS) and Revenue Market Share (RMS) growth in both existing and new accounts.


Organizational Relationship

Reporting To: Team Leader / Zonal Sales Manager


Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

Account Management

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting client relationships.
  • Deliver Data, Voice and Fixed Line business/revenue as per assigned targets.
  • New account break-in (hunting) for Data, Voice, and Fixed Line.
  • Cross-sell multi-product lines in existing customers
  • Build & maintain healthy funnels for all three Lines of Business with earmarked levels of maturity
  • Track and monitor competition plan & collect insights for market intelligence
  • Negotiate and close orders/contracts to maximize revenue.
  • Ensure timely and successful delivery of our solutions as per client needs.

jobDescription:
Job Title: Product Manager – Internet Leased Line (ILL)

Location: Pan-India (Primary Hub: Gurgaon/Regional HQ as per Business Requirement)
Department: Airtel Business – B2B Product Management
Reports To: Head – Core Product, Airtel Business

Role Summary

Airtel Business is seeking a dynamic and outcome-driven Product Manager to lead the Internet Leased Line (ILL) product portfolio – strategic business vertical. This role is instrumental in defining the vision, shaping the strategy, and driving execution for Internet as a product in the enterprise and SME segment. The ideal candidate will blend strategic thinking with tactical execution, working cross-functionally to deliver innovative solutions aligned with evolving market demands.

Key Responsibilities

1. Vision & Strategy

  • Define the end-to-end product vision and long-term strategy for Internet offerings (Internet Leased Lines, DIA, Managed Internet, etc.), ensuring scalability, competitiveness, and profitability.

  • Translate market trends, customer requirements, and technological innovations into a compelling product roadmap.

  • Own the P&L for the ILL product with a current revenue responsibility of ₹3000 Cr and target-driven growth plans.

2. Market Intelligence & Research

  • Conduct deep market research, including customer pain points, competitor analysis, industry benchmarks, and regulatory trends.

  • Engage with key stakeholders—sales teams, clients—to gather feedback and identify new opportunities for innovation and differentiation.

3. Product Roadmap & Feature Prioritization

  • Create and maintain a product roadmap aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and emerging technology trends.

  • Prioritize product enhancements and new features using data-driven frameworks that balance business impact, customer value, and technical feasibility.

4. Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, network, BSG, Sales, marketing, finance, and operations teams to drive alignment and seamless execution of the product vision.

  • Work in an Agile development environment to define product epics, user stories, and sprints, ensuring timely and high-quality product delivery.

5. Product Development & Execution

  • Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation through development, launch, and ongoing evolution.

  • Ensure high performance, availability, and SLA adherence of Internet products that cater to enterprise-grade requirements.

6. Go-to-Market (GTM) & Launch Planning

  • Drive Go-to-Market strategy, working closely with marketing to craft positioning, value propositions, messaging, and demand generation initiatives.

  • Define packaging, pricing models (flat rate, bandwidth-based, usage-based), and bundling strategies for volume and value uptake.

  • Lead the execution of product launches, training internal sales/support teams, and collecting market feedback post-launch.

7. Growth & Customer Experience

  • Constantly seek and implement opportunities to enhance customer experience, reduce churn, and increase customer lifetime value.

  • Monitor usage patterns, engage with top accounts, and influence regional product adaptations as needed.

Key Success Metrics & KPIs

  • Growth in revenue (Yo Y) for ILL portfolio

  • On-time product development and launch milestones

  • Customer acquisition and product penetration rate in core and emerging segments

  • Market share improvement vs. key competitors

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in B2B product management, preferably in telecom, enterprise connectivity, or IT services.

  • Proven experience managing high-revenue tech products (₹500 Cr+ portfolios).

  • Robust understanding of enterprise Internet technologies, network architecture, DIA, VPNs, and SD-WAN is preferred.

  • Experience working in a multi-stakeholder environment with both strategic and execution-focused responsibilities.

  • Strong analytical mindset with P&L ownership experience and expertise in commercial modelling & business case evaluations.

  • Exceptional project management and communication skills – ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams.

  • Educational background: B.Tech/BE (mandatory); MBA preferred (from Tier-1 or Tier-2 institutes).

  • Engage with key stakeholders—sales teams, clients—to gather feedback and identify new opportunities for innovation and differentiation.

3. Product Roadmap & Feature Prioritization

  • Create and maintain a product roadmap aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and emerging technology trends.

  • Prioritize product enhancements and new features using data-driven frameworks that balance business impact, customer value, and technical feasibility.

4. Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, network, BSG, Sales, marketing, finance, and operations teams to drive alignment and seamless execution of the product vision.

  • Work in an Agile development environment to define product epics, user stories, and sprints, ensuring timely and high-quality product delivery.

5. Product Development & Execution

  • Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation through development, launch, and ongoing evolution.

  • Ensure high performance, availability, and SLA adherence of Internet products that cater to enterprise-grade requirements.

  • Drive Go-to-Market strategy, working closely with marketing to craft positioning, value propositions, messaging, and demand generation initiatives.

  • Constantly seek and implement opportunities to enhance customer experience, reduce churn, and increase customer lifetime value.

  • On-time product development and launch milestones

  • Customer acquisition and product penetration rate in core and emerging segments

  • Market share improvement vs. key competitors

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience managing high-revenue tech products (₹500 Cr+ portfolios).

  • Exceptional project management and communication skills – ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams.

Job Title: International Roaming Alliance & Partnerships Head

Job Level: DGM

Function: Global Voice

Location : Airtel Centre

Reporting to : Head : Roaming & Mobile Solutions

Date : 15th July 2026

Purpose of the Job

· Responsible to Manage the P&L for the Roaming business which is contributing to NR of >50%

· Make Airtel leader in the Roaming business in India by driving cost & revenue in a direction to enhance pack coverage and total roaming revenue in collaboration with Marketing, Customer experience, network, IT and RA

Deliverables (Maximum 5-6 key responsibilities)

  • Negotiation with the Operators for the outroaming cost and Inroaming revenue, close contracts, settlements and maintain relationship with them.

  • Support the Marketing team with country coverage and cost for new packs to be launched

  • Manage traffic steering according to the negotiated rates to optimize cost and review achievements for the commitments.

  • Track the traffic, performance of the alliances regularly (revenue and cost)

  • Tap Implementation, Rating Validation, RAP monitoring and work closely with RA/Mediation/IT/Clearing House team for ensuring no revenue loss and complete billing.

  • Support Finance with accurate revenue /cost booking, timely settlement and collection, forecast, bad debt and reconciliations.

Major Challenges :

  • Single handedly manage >520 partners, large amount of follow up

  • Track traffic and revenue/cost movement

  • Revenue and cost forecasting

  • High External and Cross functional dependency

  • Up to date with market developments

  • Manage partnerships in all times zones

Prime:

· Revenue and cost projections

jobDescription:
Product Manager – SD-Branch (Naa S Portfolio)

Location: Gurgaon, India
Reports to: VP Product, Naa S

Role overview

You will own the strategy, roadmap and lifecycle of our SD-Branch portfolio: the converged set of services that make an enterprise branch site connect, run and stay secure. Your job is to turn a collection of vendor-dependent, project-delivered solutions into repeatable products that can be sold, ordered, provisioned and supported at scale.

The ideal candidate combines strong enterprise networking knowledge with product management expertise and can translate market opportunities and customer needs into differentiated products that deliver business growth and customer value.

Key responsibilities

Solution ownership

You own and evolve the branch service portfolio, spanning SDWAN and its integration with underway, managed LAN, branch security and assurance & observability.

Product Strategy

· Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for SD-Branch services.

  • Identify market opportunities, customer needs, and competitive positioning.

  • Develop business cases and investment proposals for new capabilities and enhancements.

  • Own the product lifecycle from concept through launch and ongoing optimization.

Product Development

· Gather and prioritize requirements from customers, sales, engineering, operations, and partners.

  • Create product requirements, service definitions, and feature roadmaps.

  • Work with technology and delivery teams to develop and launch new capabilities.

  • Ensure products are scalable, commercially viable, and operationally efficient.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years in product management, solution management or technical product roles, with at least 3 in enterprise networking.

  • Working depth in SD-WAN and branch networking, you can hold your own in an architecture review, and you know the practical difference between what a vendor datasheet claims and what survives contact with a 400-site rollout.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a product through a full lifecycle: definition, launch, iteration, and either scale or sunset.

  • Commercial fluency: you can build a business case, defend a price point, and explain a margin structure.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience productising services that were previously delivered as projects.

  • Familiarity with major branch vendor ecosystems (e.g. Cisco/Meraki, Fortinet)

How you work

  • You start from the customer problem, not the vendor roadmap.

  • You write things down. Clearly.

  • You are comfortable being the person who says the uncomfortable true thing in the room.

Ability to devise creative ideas to attract the target customer’s attention

Job Details


Job Title Territory Sales Manager – Mass Retail

Designation Territory Sales Manager

Job Code

Function D2C

Sub-Function Mass Retail

Location

Level/Grade Senior Executive


Position Description


The purpose of this role is to be at the frontline of the business for an entire territory with the responsibility of driving sales and end-to-end customer service. The role demands a manager who can increase market share, revenue and execute the GTM strategy. Also, the role requires to engage with channel partners & foster business relationships to enhance business for D2C mass retail.



Organizational Relationship


Reporting To Regional Mass Retail Head (~ Zonal / Area Manager)

Total number of employees supervised by you DIRECTLY or INDIRECTLY

Managerial Individual Contributors

Directly – 6 to 7

Indirectly – 6 to 7


Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities


1. Sales Management:

Drive revenue growth by focusing on new & existing channel partners and expanding the company's footprint within the territory.

Optimize the sales and distribution network to enhance market penetration of the business.

Strengthen the distribution ecosystem by increasing BTL activities in areas of operation, effective coverage, and transacting outlets.

Ensure brand visibility through organized go-to market merchandising activities to achieve tertiary recharge sales & gross prepaid targets.

2. Customer Experience:

Implement processes to enhance the overall customer experience, customer satisfaction, and issue resolution.

Ensure compliance with policies and processes by the channel partners and ensure customer SLAs are met.

Lead timely closure of service request loops & intervene and handle complaints in case of escalations.

3. Stakeholder Management:

Manage & expand channel / distributor network through incentives and seamless grievance redressal.

Form partnerships and train partners on product features / sales techniques / market positioning to strengthen the mass retail business.

Effectively implement active relationship management programs & negotiate agreements with partners to ensure mutually beneficial terms and conditions.

Maintain industry best practices to enhance the efficiency and competitiveness of services. Collect feedback and generate regular reports for improved management.

4. People Management

Lead the territory team and update their knowledge base to cater to the organizational need. Coordinate between mass retail Zonal / Area managers of sales and service.

Manage the team responsible for installing, servicing, and repairing structures and major components.

Anchor trainings as required for team member development.

Own and manage a strong people connects at all levels across the organization.

Collaborate with central functions such as marketing, finance, and HR to ensure alignment with broader company policies.


Knowledge, Certifications and Experience


Education Qualification Full time graduate degree, MBA / PGDM (optional)

Total Experience 2+ years of experience in sales preferably Telecom / FMCG


Key Interactions


Internal / External Stakeholders

(Internal means – External to the department and internal to the organization; External means – External to the organization)

Internal Zonal / Area Sales Managers & Field Sales Executives

External Urban / Rural Promoters & Channel Partners


Skills and Competencies


Technical Competencies Proficiency in sales and marketing techniques

Basic knowledge of MS Office: Excel, Power Point, Word & Outlook

title: Account Manager - SB
jobDescription:
Job Description – Account Manager

Purpose of the Job

The responsibility of the role holder is to ensure sales and service in his territory to deliver Data (Internet Bandwidth, MPLS, Cloud etc.), Voice (Postpaid), Broadband and Fixed Line Business in the assigned territory. Front-end the relationship with customer from Airtel side and become the single point of contact for customer for all three lines of business.

Ensure Customer Market Share (CMS) and Revenue Market Share (RMS) growth in both existing and new accounts.

Key Deliverables

· Deliver Data, Voice and Fixed Line installation as per assigned targets

· New account break-in (hunting) for Data, Voice and Fixed Line.

· Cross-sell multi-product lines in existing and new customer

· Build & maintain healthy funnel for all three Lines of Business with earmarked levels of maturity

· Be aware of competition plans & collect insights for market intelligence

· Monitor competition’s customer offerings and planning sales interventions for different class of clients.

Role details:

· Build and maintain strong, long lasting client relationships

· Negotiate and close orders/contracts to maximize revenue

· Develop new business through upsell and cross-sell with existing clients

· Ensure timely and successful delivery of our solutions as per client needs

Profile:

· Min Qualification: Graduate

· 1-5 years exp

· Age: upto 30 years

· Target Org: ISP/ SI (HP/Dell), FSEs from Telcos, Wireline, IT/ITe S, BFSI, any relationship based selling

Competencies:

· Persuasive communication skills

· Sales and Service orientation

· Empathy

· Tech Orientation

· Analytical skill

· Presentability

Limitless Impact: You get to make a difference to internal and external customers by taking small and big ideas to success and therefore leaving footprints at the scale of billions. And beyond.

Limitless Ownership: You get to go above and beyond to take responsibility, challenge the norms and take risks to create big things in more ways than one

Limitless Careers: You have the freedom to imagine, and an open canvas available to you to experiment and implement new ideas to gain depth and breadth of experiences.


So come join us, and #Be Limitless.


Position Description

The purpose of this role is :

  • To ensure business acquisition/growth in his territory by delivering Data (Internet Bandwidth, MPLS, Cloud etc.), Voice (Postpaid), Broadband and Fixed Line Business
  • Front-end the relationship with customer from Airtel side and become the single point of contact for customer for all three lines of business.
  • Ensure Customer Market Share (CMS) and Revenue Market Share (RMS) growth in both existing and new accounts.


Organizational Relationship

Reporting To: Team Leader / Zonal Sales Manager


Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

Account Management

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting client relationships.
  • Deliver Data, Voice and Fixed Line business/revenue as per assigned targets.
  • New account break-in (hunting) for Data, Voice, and Fixed Line.
  • Cross-sell multi-product lines in existing customers
  • Build & maintain healthy funnels for all three Lines of Business with earmarked levels of maturity
  • Track and monitor competition plan & collect insights for market intelligence
  • Negotiate and close orders/contracts to maximize revenue.
  • Ensure timely and successful delivery of our solutions as per client needs.
  • Enabling resolution of any customer issue directly/indirectly through internal support teams


Knowledge, Certifications and Experience

Education Qualification: Graduate degree preferably B. Tech/B. E

Total Experience: 2+ years of relevant work experience (B2B field sales)


Key Interactions

Internal: Distribution, network, service, HR etc.

External: Customer


Skills and Competencies

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES:

  • Understanding of technology
  • Customer Service Orientation
  • Key Account Planning & Management
  • Executive Presence – ability to handle CXO discussions
  • Commercial Acumen
  • Creative and Innovative
  • Analytical Skill


Leadership and Behavioural Competencies:

  • Customer Obsession
  • Collaboration & Influence
  • Ownership Mindset
  • Learning Agility
  • Navigating Change
  • Execution Excellence

title: Account Manager - SB
jobDescription:
Born in 1995, Airtel aims to offer global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our presence is positioned to serve nearly 96% of the nation's population with infrastructure to sustain cutting-edge technologies such as 5G, Io T, IQ, and Airtel Black. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for consumers, while also preserving the ecological balance.


We create impact, take early ownership, and experiment with different career paths as part of our cultural fabric. Here’s what you will get to experience as an Airtel employee:


Limitless Impact: You get to make a difference to internal and external customers by taking small and big ideas to success and therefore leaving footprints at the scale of billions. And beyond.

Limitless Ownership: You get to go above and beyond to take responsibility, challenge the norms and take risks to create big things in more ways than one

Limitless Careers: You have the freedom to imagine, and an open canvas available to you to experiment and implement new ideas to gain depth and breadth of experiences.


So come join us, and #Be Limitless.


Position Description

The purpose of this role is :

  • To ensure business acquisition/growth in his territory by delivering Data (Internet Bandwidth, MPLS, Cloud etc.), Voice (Postpaid), Broadband and Fixed Line Business
  • Front-end the relationship with customer from Airtel side and become the single point of contact for customer for all three lines of business.
  • Ensure Customer Market Share (CMS) and Revenue Market Share (RMS) growth in both existing and new accounts.


Organizational Relationship

Reporting To: Team Leader / Zonal Sales Manager


Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

Account Management

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting client relationships.
  • Deliver Data, Voice and Fixed Line business/revenue as per assigned targets.
  • New account break-in (hunting) for Data, Voice, and Fixed Line.
  • Cross-sell multi-product lines in existing customers
  • Build & maintain healthy funnels for all three Lines of Business with earmarked levels of maturity
  • Track and monitor competition plan & collect insights for market intelligence
  • Negotiate and close orders/contracts to maximize revenue.
  • Ensure timely and successful delivery of our solutions as per client needs.
  • Enabling resolution of any customer issue directly/indirectly through internal support teams


Knowledge, Certifications and Experience

Education Qualification: Graduate degree preferably B. Tech/B. E

Total Experience: 2+ years of relevant work experience (B2B field sales)


Key Interactions

Internal: Distribution, network, service, HR etc.

External: Customer


Skills and Competencies

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES:

  • Understanding of technology
  • Customer Service Orientation
  • Key Account Planning & Management
  • Executive Presence – ability to handle CXO discussions
  • Commercial Acumen
  • Creative and Innovative
  • Analytical Skill


Leadership and Behavioural Competencies:

  • Customer Obsession
  • Collaboration & Influence
  • Ownership Mindset
  • Learning Agility
  • Navigating Change
  • Execution Excellence

title: IOT Specialist
jobDescription:
About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic, driven, and collaborative Circle IOT Specialist to join our IOT Champs Team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys problem-solving, and wants to make a tangible impact by enabling and driving Io T/M2M growth in the circle.

As a Circle IOT Specialist, you will be the go-to person for all things Io T/M2M in the circle—supporting Account Managers (AMs), identifying new business opportunities, and ensuring seamless coordination across functions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively identify and hunt new M2M accounts within the circle.

  • Build and maintain a strong funnel for NAP (New Account Penetration) accounts.

  • Revitalize and re-engage dormant Io T/M2M accounts.

  • Enable and empower AMs to confidently sell Io T offerings.

  • Act as the Io T/M2M expert and support system for the circle.

  • Partner with AMs to ensure compliance and support restructuring related to Io T/M2M accounts.

  • Liaise effectively with cross-functional teams to align on business goals and ensure seamless execution.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • Proven B2B sales experience

  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.

  • Minimum of 12 months experience as an Account Manager, with basic understanding of IOT/M2M offering, internal processes and role/ responsibilities of cross-functional teams.

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.

What Makes This Role Unique?

This is a high-visibility role with opportunities to collaborate closely with sales teams, finance, product, and cross functional teams. It’s ideal for someone who is enthusiastic about Io T/M2M, eager to learn constantly, and committed to delivering impact. The role requires strong collaboration skills while keeping business and sales priorities at the center of all decisions.

Minimum of 12 months experience as an Account Manager, with basic understanding of IOT/M2M offering, internal processes and role/ responsibilities of cross-functional teams. Educational Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in any discipline. What Makes This Role Unique? This is a high-visibility role with opportunities to collaborate closely with sales teams, finance, product, and cross functional teams. It’s ideal for someone who is enthusiastic about Io T/M2M, eager to learn constantly, and committed to delivering impact. The role requires strong collaboration skills while keeping business and sales priorities at the center of all decisions. title: Lead - B2B Distribution
jobDescription:
Purpose of the Job

The responsibility of the role holder is to set up and govern distribution for the B2B business in the Circle, ensure the right structure and right people placement to deliver business results, and maintain a high level of hygiene parameters to enable Sales team to deliver on productivity and delivery targets

Key Deliverables

title: Area Manager
location: UP-Meerut-Area Office, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh , India
jobDescription:
JOB DESCRIPTION


Born in 1995, Airtel aims to offer global connectivity and unlock endless opportunities. Our presence is positioned to serve nearly 96% of the nation's population with infrastructure to sustain cutting-edge technologies such as 5G, Io T, IQ, and Airtel Black. At Airtel, we strive to go beyond our duties to create impactful solutions for consumers, while also preserving the ecological balance.


We create impact, take early ownership, and experiment with different career paths as part of our cultural fabric. Here’s what you will get to experience as an Airtel employee:


Limitless Impact:


You get to make a difference to internal and external customers by taking small and big ideas to success and therefore leaving footprints at the scale of billions. And beyond. Limitless Ownership:


You get to go above and beyond to take responsibility, challenge the norms and take risks to create big things in more ways than one. Limitless Careers:


You have the freedom to imagine, and an open canvas available to you to experiment and implement new ideas to gain depth and breadth of experiences.


So come join us, and #Be Limitless. Because you are.


Job Details


Job Title Area Sales Manager – D2C

Designation Area Sales Manager

Job Code

Function D2C

Sub-Function Operations

Location

Level/Grade Manager


Position Description


The purpose of this role is to spearhead delivery of all lines of businesses in the assigned geography (smaller circles) to maximise extraction while providing quality service to customers. The role is also responsible to lead both retail teams (mostly Postpaid) & Broadband teams with the aim to increase engagement within residential societies (RWAs) as the preferred service provider and additionally ensuring successful in-store operations.


Organizational Relationship


Reporting To Circle Retail Head / D2C Head

Total number of employees supervised by you DIRECTLY or INDIRECTLY

Managerial Individual Contributors

Directly 5 to 10 -

Indirectly – -


Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities


Business Strategy & Planning:

Execute strategic plans for the D2C business in the assigned geography, aligning with overall organizational goals and market dynamics.

Drive revenue growth by implementing effective distribution strategies to build channel productivity ensuring maximum market coverage & visibility for company’s D2C products.

Manage budgets for the business, ensuring efficient resource allocation and adherence to financial targets.

Sales Management:

Optimize the sales and distribution network to enhance market penetration and ensure a robust channel presence.

Manage the D2C product portfolio, including pricing strategies, packaging, and feature enhancements.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with market dynamics, regulatory changes, and operational challenges, ensuring business continuity.

Store Operations:

Manage store profitability through delivery of agreed revenue/cost plan and ensure deployment of programs across all stores.

Implement processes to enhance the overall customer experience, focusing on service quality, customer satisfaction, and issue resolution.

Conduct thorough store/zone level analysis to identify trends, customer preferences, and competitive landscape, providing insights for informed decision-making.

Stakeholder Management:

Form partnerships and alliances with residential societies (RWA’s) to advance the D2C business and drive Airtel as the preferred service provider.

Adopt industry best practices to enhance the efficiency and competitiveness of services.

Work on potential conflicts or challenges in the stakeholder ecosystem and work towards timely resolution.

People Management

Review and monitor performance of Territory Managers and Store Managers on an ongoing basis and provide requisite developmental support / inputs.

Develop the team and update their knowledge base to cater to the organizational need.

Anchor trainings as required for team member development.

Chart out a clear talent development plan and identifies and grooms team members for higher responsibilities.

Own and manage strong people connects at all levels across the organization.

Collaborate with zonal/circle teams and central functions such as marketing, finance & HR to ensure alignment with broader company policies.


Knowledge, Certifications and Experience


Education Qualification Graduate (Full time), Master’s degree in business administration from Tier 1/2 Business School

Total Experience 6-8 years of work experience in Sales or Marketing or Service in a leadership role from Media / Consumer Electronic / Telco or related industry


Key Interactions


Internal / External Stakeholders

(Internal means – External to the department and internal to the organization; External means – External to the organization)

Internal Territory Managers / Store Managers / Cross functional teams

External Local Cable Operators


Skills and Competencies


Technical Competencies

Proficiency in sales and marketing techniques

Knowledge of building retail channels and service operations


Leadership and Behavioural Competencies Problem Solving

Analytical Skills

Communication Skills (oral/written)

Interpersonal Skills

Teamwork and Collaboration

Result Orientation

Multi-tasking

Enterprising

Customer Obsession

Positive Drive and Energy
